summary: community.hashi_vault v7.0.0 will drop support for several ansible-core and Python versions, focusing on currently supported releases.
questions: Will community.hashi_vault drop support for older ansible-core versions?
Which Python versions will hashi_vault 7 support?

answer_card.title: hashi_vault 7.0.0 version support
answer_card.answer_md: community.hashi_vault 7.0.0 will drop several ansible-core and Python versions. It will support currently maintained ansible-core releases and the controller Python versions they support, plus a subset of target versions.
